title: ReNew’s Watts & Whys new podcast
summary: As the global economy navigates geopolitical uncertainty, shifting supply chains, technological disruption and the energy transition, India stands at a pivotal moment in its growth journey. In the latest edition of ReNew’s Watts & Whys podcast, Dr V. Anantha Nageswaran, Chief Economic Adviser to the Government of India, joins ReNew Founder, Chairman and CEO Sumant Sinha for a wide-ranging conversation on “India’s Economic Moment in a Fragmented World.” The discussion explores India’s growth outlook, manufacturing ambitions, industrial competitiveness and the opportunities emerging from a rapidly changing global landscape. It also examines the increasingly important connections between energy security, technology and economic development, and what they mean for India’s long-term prosperity and resilience. Watch the full conversation.
